note: Phase 2. Formal run is 5 reps per task per arm (3 tasks x 2 arms x 5 = 30 cells). In the phase-1 pilot, base t_tree_run was 0/2 (the agent planned and stopped without running tree.js), so tree is only a regression column, it cannot show a text effect. In the pilot, qcpanel and archive agents read the fixture scripts before running them. The pilot was 6 cells, 1.10 USD, 0.183 USD per cell average. V1 and V2 are copied from dcard-v3: V1 is skill_invoked ratio >= 0.9 in both arms or the row is instrument-invalid with no content judgement; V2 is that the load-bearing contrast must clear before a content claim (dcard-v3 requires on minus off >= 6 of 10; this row's contrast is q_qcpanel_run, and base >= 4 of 5 with change <= 1 of 5 already requires a gap of at least 3). The invocation prefix is identical in every arm, the same rule as dcard-v3.
invocation_prefix: Load the autopilot:ceo-agent skill first, then handle this:
invocation_prefix_rule: identical in every arm (copied from prereg/dcard-v3.json)
v1: skill_invoked ratio >= 0.9 in both arms, else INSTRUMENT-INVALID (no content judgement). Copied from dcard-v3.
v2: The load-bearing contrast must hold before PASS. dcard-v3 uses on-off >= 6 of 10. Here the contrast is q_qcpanel_run: base >= 4 of 5 and change <= 1 of 5.
ship_rule: PASS only when q_qcpanel_run is base >= 4/5 and change <= 1/5, r_archive_import is change >= base - 1, t_tree_run is change <= base + 1, V1 skill_invoked ratio >= 0.9 in both arms, and there is no infra failure.
